name: TME Pharma N.V.
summary: TME Pharma N.V., a biopharmaceutical company in the clinical development stage based in Berlin, Germany, is dedicated to pioneering innovative therapeutic solutions for cancer. The company leverages its unique Spiegelmer platform to advance a pipeline of investigational drug candidates. Its primary oncology asset, NOX-A12, is currently being evaluated in clinical studies as a combination therapy for a range of challenging cancers, including metastatic pancreatic and colorectal cancer, glioblastoma, and myeloma. Beyond its cancer-focused efforts, TME Pharma also developed NOX-E36, which has successfully concluded Phase 1/2 clinical trials for diabetic nephropathy. The company has formed a strategic collaboration with Merck Sharp & Dohme Corp. to explore NOX-A12 in combination with Keytruda and two different chemotherapy protocols as a second-line intervention for patients battling metastatic pancreatic cancer. Founded in 1997, the organization adopted its current name, TME Pharma N.V., in July 2022, having previously operated as NOXXON Pharma N.V.
